newsitem.title: USA: IBM raised to strong buy - Merrill Lynch.
newsitem.headline: IBM raised to strong buy - Merrill Lynch.

text.p: Merrill Lynch analyst Daniel Mandresh raised his near-term rating on International Business Machines Corp to a strong buy from accumulate, market sources said, and he maintains a long-term strong buy.

Traders said that Mandresh said his conviction for the company's third and fourth quarter earnings outlook is rising, because the company's new mainframes and disk drives will reach meaningful volumes in the third and fourth quarters.
Mandresh has a 12-month price target of $150, based on a slight improvement in the company's price/earnings ratio.
Mandresh was not immediately available to comment.
Mandresh maintains his 1996 earnings estimates of $11.75 a share, and his 1997 earnings estimates of $13.75 a share, traders said. IBM's shares were up 3-1/2 in heavy trading.
